proof_repairs.old: Changing a root parameter gives the inverse square of the tangent-frame change.
proof_repairs.exact_map: Dprime=aD sends each differentiated column to a times that column, hence determinant coefficient to a^2. The dual differential frame changes by a^-1, and its square by a^-2.
proof_repairs.explicit_test: For U=(e1,e2), differentiated columns(e3,e4) and Dprime=2D, the coefficient changes from1 to4, whereas the literal inverse-square rule would give1/4.
proof_repairs.resolution: Display coefficient and differential-frame maps and their product. Labels, determinant line, ranks and all statement conclusions are unchanged.

proof_repairs.location: E16 proof items2 and5, integral leading-matrix wording
proof_repairs.old: The logarithmic derivative is identified literally with an integral monodromy matrix while D=q d/dq is fixed.
proof_repairs.exact_map: In the primary frame e_i=alpha_i+(log q)/(2 pi i) beta_i, nabla e_i=beta_i dq/(2 pi iq). Thus the quotient derivative is (2 pi i)^-1 diag(1,epsilon), and at the comb cusp (2 pi i)^-1 I. With cohomological N=T-I, the source convention gives N e_i=-f_i, so the residue is -N/(2 pi i).
proof_repairs.resolution: Use the exact period derivative and its nonzero scalar; rank and zero orders stay the same.
